data.title: Industrial Automation
data.tagline: Control architecture, robotics, and line integration engineered for uptime.
data.overview: Meridian designs and commissions automation systems that connect machines, safety, and production data into one dependable operating layer. We work backwards from the process: cycle time, quality, and maintainability come before hardware selection.

problems.title: Islands of automation
problems.description: Machines from different vendors run in isolation, so operators reconcile performance by hand.

problems.title: Fragile changeovers
problems.description: Product changes require engineering intervention and hours of unplanned downtime.

problems.title: Data without trust
problems.description: Dashboards exist, but no one can trace a number back to a verified signal.

approach.title: Process and risk assessment
approach.description: We map the real production flow, constraints, and failure modes before proposing equipment.

approach.title: Control architecture
approach.description: A documented PLC, safety, network, and data architecture that vendors can build against.

approach.title: Build and commissioning
approach.description: Factory acceptance testing, staged commissioning, and operator training with measurable acceptance criteria.

approach.title: Operate and improve
approach.description: Performance reviews and controlled improvements after handover, not a departure at switch-on.

capabilities.title: PLC, HMI, SCADA and safety
capabilities.description: Multi-vendor control and safety integration with documented interfaces.

capabilities.title: Robotic cells
capabilities.description: Cell design, end-of-arm tooling, guarding, and cycle-time validation.

capabilities.title: Line simulation
capabilities.description: Virtual commissioning to test logic before the line stops for installation.

capabilities.title: Legacy migration
capabilities.description: Phased replacement of obsolete controls without a full-plant shutdown.

benefits.title: Stable cycle times
benefits.description: Control logic tuned to the real operating envelope, not the brochure.

benefits.title: Faster changeovers
benefits.description: Recipes, tooling, and operator guidance designed as one system.

benefits.title: Traceable quality
benefits.description: Every result linked to machine, batch, and operator context.

benefits.title: Lower maintenance burden
benefits.description: Spare-part strategy, diagnostics, and documentation that local teams can use.
